sections.title: Personalized courses
sections.text: If you've saved which courses/electives you're enrolled in, you can automatically hide all lessons that don't apply to you. You can adjust your selection in the group settings under “My courses”. If you still want to see all lessons, you can turn off this option in your account menu.

sections.title: Live updates
sections.text: Substitutions, cancellations, room changes, etc. are entered by moderators and admins – unless your group's permissions say otherwise – and show up right away in the digital schedule.
